note: first serve came up CPU-only: ggml_cuda_init failed (unknown error) in every --gpus all container after today's reboot. Root cause: /etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml (generated 2026-09-23) baked in nvidia-uvm major 237; kernel re-registered uvm as major 238 across the reboot. Fixed with: nvidia-ctk cdi generate --output=/etc/cdi/nvidia.yaml. cuInit/cuCtxCreate then verified rc=0 in stock --gpus all container. Also learned: wrapper entrypoint needs -s -m and explicit --host 0.0.0.0 (default binds container-loopback, -p forward gets RST) and --metrics for the acceptance harness.
